A Specialist is a citizen of a city who works no tile. Its class is its kind, so changing one replaces it with an instance of another class from AvailableSpecialistRegistry, whose order is the order a player cycles through them. Cities expose their specialists as the `specialists` additional data.

A city's citizens are its worked tiles (the centre included) plus its specialists, and there are size + 1 of them. assignWorkers, assignWorker, reassignWorkers and changeWorkedTile now count both:
taking a worker off a tile makes them a specialist of the first available kind;
working an unworked tile uses up a specialist, Entertainers first;
a new citizen with no tile left to work becomes a specialist;
reassignWorkers keeps the city's specialists and rearranges only its tiles.

New helpers: citizenCount, addSpecialist, changeSpecialist (cycles to the next kind), and releaseCitizens (drops specialists before the least valuable tiles when a city has too many citizens). The new registry parameters are optional and trail the existing ones, so current callers are unaffected.
